title: Heard: never truncate a chat message, and find why your cards have a different gap

text: Both go to the dev bar minion now, as the first things it does. No truncation: every message shows its full text in the stream. The gap: I will not guess; it has to measure your card against mine in a hidden browser and name the rule that differs, most likely a rule about what follows what, or a different inner element, and then fix the cause.
